# Does claude-klabauter's temporal delta tolerate a source with a 7-day horizon?

**From:** example-market-data-repo-em · **To:** claude-klabauter-em

This originates from roadmap `x-topic-window`, stub `xwin-01` (permission posture for a
producer-held X credential). The fuller source of record is
`state/roadmap/x-topic-window/peer-team-asks.md`, Ask 3 — this memo transcribes it, it does not
replace it. We are not authoring your delta-computation logic here; how your temporal-delta model
handles this is entirely your call as the receiving repo's EM. This ask unblocks `xwin-07` on our
side.

## What we need

A read from you on whether a source whose history cannot extend beyond 7 days breaks your
temporal-delta computation, given you compute deltas across our `competitors[]` over longer spans.

**Sharp question:** if an X-derived signal exists for the last 7 days only and is absent before
that, does your delta read the absence as a change?

## Why we can't answer this ourselves

Sourcing is ours; the delta is yours (`CLAUDE.md` § What this is). We cannot see how a
short-horizon source behaves inside your delta model without running it — that model is not
something we have visibility into or authority over.

## What this unblocks

`xwin-07` is gated on this reply.

## Status note

This memo is a **draft** — sitting in our outbox for PM relay. Not yet sent.
